name: Eco Trail Ultra
description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the race offers a variety of routes, including the 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The race kit includes a race bib with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from 28 November to 1 December 2026, with exhibitions, race-kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a good cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Sfântul Nectarie' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options: 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: The event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: 4 Run 4 Fun 2026 – Etapa 4 (Alergarea de Moș Nicolae)
Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. The event includes online registration, race kit collection on 12.12.2026, and access to results and photos after the event.

name: ULTRA ZĂRAND SERIES
description: Ultra Zărand Series is an ultra-trail race held in the Zarand Mountains, near the village of Cășoaia in Arad County, Romania. The event takes place from 11 to 13 December 2026 and offers long-distance routes through scenic landscapes, promoting local tourism and the region’s natural and cultural heritage. Participants can choose from various distances, including an ultramarathon, and enjoy a trail-running experience amid mountain nature. The organizers, ACS ULTRA PANA LA CAPAT, invite experienced runners to discover the beauty of the Zarand area at this special event.
course_highlights: Scenic mountain routes in the Zarand Mountains
Various distances, including an ultramarathon
Promotes the region’s natural and cultural heritage
additional: Available distances: Ultra; The routes cross the Zarand Mountains, a scenic region for winter trail running.

ORADEA CITY TRAIL RUN
location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

description: The Gerar Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Romania, held on the campus of the Polytechnic University of Bucharest. The competition promotes outdoor running and team spirit, welcoming both individual runners and teams of three. The course is an approximately 3.6 km loop, completed multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The event takes place on the last weekend of January and attracts more than 850 active participants.
course_highlights: A 3.6 km loop on the Polytechnic University campus
Start/finish in front of the Faculty of Transport
The half marathon covers 6 loops for a distance of 21.8 km
additional: Race kits can be collected at the Rectorate building – AN wing, on the campus of the Polytechnic University of Bucharest, on Friday, January 29, 2027, from 17:00 to 20:00, and on Saturday, January 30, 2027, at different times for each race. Car access to campus is prohibited on race day. The half marathon is limited to 200 teams, and the half marathon fee is paid collectively for all team members. Car access to campus is prohibited on race day; information is available about public transport and nearby parking.

name: FAGET WINTER TRAIL Padurea Faget.
description: Faget Winter Race is a mountain running event held in Faget Forest, Cluj-Napoca, now in its 12th edition. The competition offers three distances: 7 km, 15 km, and a half marathon, on marked routes featuring climbs and descents along forest trails and tourist paths. Participants can use refreshment and aid stations along the course, access medical assistance, and compete for category prizes. The event is open to runners over 18, with minors permitted to participate with special approvals.
course_highlights: Marked mountain routes with elevation gains of 243 m (7 km) and 688 m (15 km)
Refreshment and aid stations at key points along the course
The route passes through forest, open clearings, and marked tourist trails
additional: The start is at Unirea Sports Base; the half marathon starts at 10:00, the 15 km race at 10:30, and the 7 km race at 11:00. Race kits must be collected in person and include a race number that must be worn visibly, an electronic certificate, and product/voucher prizes. Mandatory equipment includes trail running shoes, protective clothing, and a reusable bottle/cup. Participation is limited to 500 competitors, and registration is online only.

name: Făget Winter Race
description: Făget Winter Race is a mountain running event held in Făget Forest in Cluj-Napoca, now in its 12th edition. On January 23, 2027, participants can choose from three events: 7 km, 15 km, and a half marathon. The varied routes feature significant elevation changes, offering a challenging and scenic experience in nature. The event is open to runners over 18, as well as minors with special approval. The organizers provide aid stations and medical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: Marked mountain routes with elevation gains of 243 m (7 km) and 688 m (15 km)
Aid stations at key points along the route (3.4 km, 6.4 km, 9.3 km)
The route passes through forest, open clearings, and marked hiking trails
additional: The participant limit is 500. Race kits must be collected in person and include a race bib that must be worn visibly, an electronic diploma, and prizes in the form of products/vouchers. Mandatory equipment includes trail running shoes, a rain/wind jacket or long-sleeved top, and a water bottle or reusable cup. Energy bars or gels and a charged mobile phone are also recommended. Running with pets is prohibited. The routes follow forest trails and are marked. Hydration points are provided along the route and at the finish for the 15 km and 8 km events.

name: SKV Vertical Race
description: SKV Vertical Race is a winter mountain-running competition held in the Brașov area, with courses starting in the Tâmpa area. The 21 km half marathon includes a climb up Tâmpa’s switchbacks, followed by descents and sections on trails marked with different symbols, offering an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both amateurs and professionals and takes place in winter conditions, requiring mountain experience and adequate physical preparation. The organizers provide safety measures and course markings, and participants receive personalized kits.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon course with 1,128 m of elevation gain
Climb up Tâmpa’s switchbacks and descents on marked trails (Blue Stripe, Yellow Stripe, Blue Triangle, Blue Cross)
Run in winter conditions, with natural obstacles and varied mountain terrain
additional: A personalized race kit is guaranteed for registrations during the Early Bird and Special Promo periods. The event also includes a night mountain-running race (Night Run), starting at 17:30 on the day before the half marathon. Kits can be collected in the Promenada Tâmpa area, either the day before or on race day. The awards ceremonies take place after the races finish.

description: Șiria Winter Trail is a mountain running competition for both amateur and professional runners, promoting short- and middle-distance running in the Zărand Mountains, Arad County. The event combines sport and tourism, following routes that include historical and natural landmarks such as Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, and Feredeu Hermitage. The competition features three easy- and moderate-difficulty races on varied, marked routes, with the start and finish at the “Ioan Slavici” House of Culture in Șiria. It is a challenge suited to trained, experienced runners with appropriate equipment.
course_highlights: Mountain routes featuring historical landmarks: Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, and Feredeu Hermitage
Routes consist of marked hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Elevation gains ranging from 365 m to 1070 m across distances of 6 km, 10 km, and 21 km
additional: The race kit includes a sweatshirt, a hat, and gloves; these must be reserved when registering. There are hydration and fueling stations along the routes. The mandatory equipment includes a race bib. Recommended equipment includes trekking poles, energy gels, gloves, a water bottle, and clothing suitable for winter conditions. The routes are marked with tape and arrows, and participants must pass through all checkpoints to avoid disqualification. The start and finish are at the “Ioan Slavici” House of Culture in Șiria. The routes include hiking and local trails, forest roads, and paved sections; participants must provide their own food and hydration.

name: Vlădeasa Winter Trail
description: Vlădeasa Winter Trail is a mountain running race held in the Rogojel area, in the heart of the Vlădeasa Mountains. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and challenging courses, which offer runners an authentic winter experience in nature. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and event organization dedicated to trail running enthusiasts. The competition attracts both experienced runners and amateurs eager to discover the beauty of mountain running in the cold season.
course_highlights: Mountain courses in the Vlădeasa Mountains with winter scenery
Varied difficulty, suitable for runners of all levels
Friendly atmosphere and organization dedicated to trail running enthusiasts

description: Scorilo Winter Trail is a mountain running competition held in Poiana Mărului, Caraș-Severin, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes races with significant elevation gain and spectacular scenery, such as the Scorila rock formations and the mountain peaks of the Țarcu area. Participants can choose from several distances, from a mountain marathon to races for children and families, all organized to internationally recognized standards. It is an experience that combines athletic challenge with natural beauty and community spirit.
course_highlights: Mountain course with up to 2,653 m of elevation gain at Țarcu Marathon
Passing the Scorila rock formation, which is associated with a Dacian legend
Running over the Brusturu and Căleanu peaks, with alpine sections and technical terrain
additional: Race kits can be collected at Pine Hill cabin in the Start/Finish area. Each race has time limits (cutoffs), and participants who exceed them are stopped. The event provides official T-shirts and medals for participants. There are races for children and families, as well as races with significant elevation gain for experienced runners.

description: Team Up & Run is a dynamic team running competition combining speed, endurance, and athletic skill challenges, including stair climbing. The event emphasizes coordination and mutual support among team members, making it ideal for friends, colleagues, or family. Participants form teams of three and can enjoy an energetic, challenging team-building experience. Everyone who finishes the race receives a medal, and the winning teams are awarded trophies.
course_highlights: Course consisting of three sections
Includes climbing and descending stairs, slopes, and ramps
The event combines running with fitness and athletic skill challenges
additional: The maximum number of teams is limited to 60, divided equally between the two races. Registration is exclusively online, and payment can be made by card or bank transfer. The minimum age for participation is 16. Medals are awarded to all participants who finish the race. Participants must be at least 16 years old. The “Together” and “Relay” races are mentioned.

name: RUBICON - CURSA EROILOR Ultramaraton: Bucuresti - Chisinau
description: Rubicon is a unique ultramarathon held along the Bucharest–Chișinău route, divided into 46 stages crossing Romania’s counties and the regions of the Republic of Moldova. Participants can choose how many stages to complete and create their own race strategy, with no restrictions on the number of stages. For each stage completed in a county, runners receive a medal bearing that county’s coat of arms, and the winner receives a special shield for the badges collected. The event promotes the sport, culture, and history of the regions along the route and is open to both amateurs and professionals.
course_highlights: The route is divided into 46 stages, with each county having between 1 and 10 stages
Medals bearing each county’s coat of arms are awarded for every stage completed
The route crosses regions of Romania and the Republic of Moldova, promoting local culture and history
additional: The official race start is in Bucharest, and participants can request transport by special bus from the “Arcul de Triumf” Stadium. The race follows the eastern route through Romania and the Republic of Moldova. The organizer is A.O. Clubul sportiv "Sporter". To receive a region’s medal, participants must complete at least one stage in that region.

name: Crosul Divelor
location: Platoul Sălii Sporturilor Horia Demian, Cluj-Napoca, Romania
description: Crosul Divelor powered by 8x8 is the first running race in Cluj-Napoca dedicated exclusively to women and girls. The event offers a friendly, fun atmosphere, inviting participants to run and enjoy being active in a special setting. It takes place at the Horia Demian Sports Hall Esplanade and is part of the Runners Club event series, known for organizing a variety of appealing races. The race also supports a charitable cause, adding extra meaning to taking part.
course_highlights: A race dedicated exclusively to women
Central location: Horia Demian Sports Hall Esplanade
Friendly, fun atmosphere
additional: A registration kit is provided to participants. The event supports a charitable cause, Run for Alex Mâță. The organizer offers free group training sessions for the local running community. The event is charitable; the announced cause is “Run for Alex Mâță!”.

name: Alerg pentru mama
description: The “I Run for Mom” charity run is an accessible, friendly race for children, adults, and families, opening the running season in Suceava County. The event promotes solidarity and community involvement, supporting the Casa ADRA project. It brings together both beginner runners and people who want to combine exercise with a socially meaningful gesture.
course_highlights: An accessible race for all ages and experience levels
A charity event supporting Casa ADRA
A friendly, welcoming atmosphere for families and the community

name: TIMISOARA 21K Povestea aleargă mai departe.
description: TIMIȘOARA 21k is the first stage in the 21k.ro series, a series of road races connecting cities and communities across Romania. The event offers a unique experience, with an energetic and welcoming vibe that reflects Timișoara’s cultural and European spirit. Runners are invited to take on a course that grows in intensity and challenge from one stage to the next, with a gamification system that encourages progress and participation. Organized by Yolo Events, this race is more than a competition: it’s a revolution in road running that keeps you coming back and pushing your limits.
course_highlights: The 21k series begins in Timișoara, the cultural capital
An urban course with the city’s characteristic energy and welcoming spirit
Part of a gamification system with levels and goals for runners
additional: The 21k series includes several stages in different cities, culminating in a grand finale in Bucharest. The event is organized by Yolo Events, known for thoughtfully designed sporting experiences and real communities. Participants can earn a special 21k bracelet that reflects their level and progress in the series. The race is also presented under the name “Timișoara 21k by SportGuru”.

name: Primavera Trail Race
description: Ave Romania Primavera Trail Race is a mountain running competition organized by AS Xterra Sport Bihor, held in the village of Șuncuiuș, at the entrance to the Crișului Gorge. The routes follow forest roads and marked hiking trails, passing some of the most beautiful attractions of the Pădurea Craiului Mountains. The race is technical and difficult, with significant elevation changes, offering a serious challenge for endurance runners. Three routes are available: Marathon (42.8 km, +2120 m elevation gain), Cross (16.2 km, +990 m) and Wild (10.2 km, +460 m).
course_highlights: Routes on forest roads and marked hiking trails
Significant elevation changes; technical and difficult course
Scenery and natural attractions in the Pădurea Craiului Mountains and Crișului Gorge
additional: Participants must be at least 16 years old and fit for endurance running. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent/guardian and copies of their ID cards. Organizers may withdraw competitors who are intoxicated, under the influence of substances, or lack appropriate equipment. All participants must follow the marked route and the officials’ instructions. Prizes are awarded only in categories with at least 5 competitors. Registration is exclusively through the webshop, with secure payment. The Marathon has a time limit of 9 hours, and the Cross race has a time limit of 4 hours. Finishers who meet the time limits receive personalized medals.

name: Crosul pentru viață
location: Parcul Alexandru Ioan Cuza (IOR), Bucharest, Romania
organizer: Centrele ROUA, în colaborare cu Pegas Triatlon Club
description: Crosul pentru Viață is an annual charity sporting event held in Alexandru Ioan Cuza Park (IOR) in Bucharest, supporting social causes related to the protection of life. Participants can choose between two adult races: 11 km (three laps of the lake) and 3 km (one lap of the lake), while children aged 3 to 14 run distances adapted to their age groups. The event promotes outdoor activity and solidarity, and the funds raised go to the ROUA Centers, which support pregnant women and mothers with babies. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with prizes and participation medals for all runners.
course_highlights: The course runs through Alexandru Ioan Cuza Park, along the path around the lake
The 11 km race consists of three laps of the lake, while the 3 km race consists of one lap
The children’s race has distances from 200 m to 1,000 m, depending on age group
additional: Race-kit pickup takes place between 08:00 and 09:00 at the wooden gazebo near the stage. The 11 km and 3 km races start at 09:30, and the Children’s Race starts at 11:30, with starts organized by age group. All participants receive a participation medal made of Horezu pottery, access to hydration points along the course and at the finish, medical assistance, and prizes. Participants receive a 30% discount on Cozia Mountain Run 2026 with code CPV26. Registration is not available on race day.

description: SportGuru Timișoara 21k is an international half marathon held in the heart of Timișoara, offering a premium experience for both elite runners and passionate amateurs. The event features a wonderful route full of energy and fun, passing through important areas of the city. It brings the running community together and promotes the spirit of sport with the slogan “Start Running Purple.”
course_highlights: Urban route through Piața Libertății and central areas of Timișoara
International event with broad participation from amateur and professional runners
Vibrant atmosphere and community support throughout the race
additional: The start and finish area is in Piața Libertății, Timișoara. Several races are available: 21k, 10k, 5k, and 2.5k Kids Run. Registration is online via the form on the website. The event also includes training programs and charitable activities. No details have been published about start times or registration fees for the 2027 edition. Sport Expo and race kit pickup take place at Iulius Town Timișoara.

description: Crosul Primăverii is a running competition that opens the official running season in Baia Mare, for people over 15 years old. The event offers two main races, one 3 km and one 6 km, as well as a combo option for both distances. It is a race about motivation, community, and the joy of running beneath the clear spring sky, carefully organized to provide all participants with an enjoyable and competitive experience.
course_highlights: 3 km Popular Race with a 30-minute time limit
6 km Cross-Country Race with age categories and a 60-minute time limit
Combo option for both races with one race T-shirt
additional: On-site registration is available only for the 3 km Popular Race, with no guarantee of a race kit. Separate prizes for the OPEN podium and age categories. Bank transfer is available for paying the participation fee. The event is for participants over 15 years old.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race held in Băneasa Forest in Bucharest. It has grown organically since its first edition in 2018, reaching more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: half marathon (21 km), cross-country (11 km), sprint (6 km), and Family Run (3 km), so every runner can find the right challenge. The varied courses include trails, dirt roads, and asphalt, offering an enjoyable experience in nature, with well-positioned refreshment stations. Băneasa Forest Run is about the joy of running in the forest, whether you run competitively or for fun with your family.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with trails, dirt roads, and asphalt
A range of distances: half marathon 21 km, cross-country 11 km, sprint 6 km, and Family Run 3 km
Refreshment stations at the start, km 3.3, km 5, km 9, and the finish, with water, isotonic drink, and food
additional: The routes may include elevation changes, roots, and vegetation; rain may bring puddles and mud. Group training sessions are organized for different paces, with coordinators. Refreshment stations along the routes offer water, isotonic drink, and food.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

name: BRAȘOV 21K Run the City. Feel the Mountains.
Maratonul Argonauților
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in Cheile Dobrogei, offering a unique experience amid the natural scenery of the area’s geological and birdlife reserves. The marathon course has 1,600 meters of positive elevation gain, challenging runners to discover the beauty and demands of the terrain. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and includes several races for participants of all categories, promoting both sport and local tourism. Participants are invited to explore Cheile and Gura Dobrogei in a competitive and friendly setting.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 1,600 meters of positive elevation gain
Spectacular scenery in the Cheile and Gura Dobrogei Geological and Birdlife Reserves
Mountain course that tests runners’ endurance and technique
additional: Several races are available: Marathon, Chifu Ioan Half Marathon, Cross-Country Race, Family Race, and Cheile Circuit. Entry fees are fixed for each race, with no explicit mention of pricing periods or additional fees. The courses are promoted as part of local tourism and include protected nature reserves.

name: La Petrovaselo în vie
description: Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to running in nature, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to take up outdoor running. Organized by Clubul Sportiv Asociația Alergotura in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, the event offers three races of varying distances along scenic routes in the Petro Vaselo vineyard area. Participants can enjoy an outdoor sporting experience with well-marked routes and refreshment stations in a friendly, well-organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, provided upon presentation of their race number.

description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, on hiking trails in the Zărand Mountains, between the towns of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event connects two important historic fortresses, Șoimoș Fortress and Șiria Fortress, promoting the area’s natural and historic heritage. The routes offer an adventurous experience and outstanding spring scenery, and are suitable for both amateurs and professionals. The competition is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendars and is organized by the În Amonte Tourism Association.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with elevation gains ranging from 445 m to 2075 m
Passes historic landmarks: Șoimoș Fortress, Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, and Feredeu Hermitage
Marked hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads, indicated with ribbons and arrows
additional: The participant kit is guaranteed only for registrations made by April 12. The routes have hydration and refreshment stations, and the competition has medical assistance and Salvamont monitoring. On-site registration is available only for the 9 km cross-country race and the 22 km half marathon, subject to availability and without a guaranteed kit.

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition held in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running on varied terrain, including forest trails and forestry roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked course with checkpoints and a friendly atmosphere, rounded off with an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch. The start is scheduled for 10:00, following a technical briefing and a coffee-fueled warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting outdoor physical activity.

name: Brăila 10K
description: Brăila 10K is a running race held in Monument Park in Brăila, offering an energetic and welcoming experience for runners of all ages. The event includes 10.5 km, 7 km, and 3.5 km races, children’s races, and a 1.5 km Family Fun Run, making it ideal for setting a personal best on a fast, well-marked course. The festival atmosphere, music, prizes, and activities for the whole family make Brăila 10K a celebration of outdoor movement and health. The organizers emphasize safety and the smooth running of the competition, with volunteers and referees along the course.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charity mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in Urlați, Prahova County, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateurs and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and can go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cut-off time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, as well as support for social and educational causes, promoting wine culture and local tourism.

name: Alergăraș în Făgăraș
description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity is a sporting and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support children with cancer. The event aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the “Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, ranging from a 3 km run to a 2-hour race. All races take place along the Someș Promenade, starting and finishing near the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall. All funds raised from registration fees go directly to the charity project.

name: Maratonul Codrului
location: Popasul Codrenilor, Oțeloaia, Homoroade, Satu Mare County, Romania
description: Codrului Marathon is an MTB and trail running event organized by Pro Racers Sports Club and the Romanian Cycling Federation, for both amateurs and professionals. The spectacular routes cross forests and offer challenges for all fitness levels, with new and more appealing options for the MTB and trail running events. The event also includes races for children, race packs, hydration stations, medical assistance, timing, and a finisher medal for all participants. It is an event for the community and families, with a friendly atmosphere and comprehensive support for runners.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, excluding the road section from the last 5 km
Varied trail running routes, with 6 km and 13 km hobby options
Significant climbs on routes with elevation gains ranging from 250 m to 1,150 m
additional: The event offers race packs with a race number and sponsor products (limited to 250 packs), photos from the course, hydration stations along the course and at the finish, medical assistance and Mountain Rescue, timing, a pasta party, and finisher medals. Official SPORT HG technical tops, model 2026, are available as an optional purchase. The schedule includes multiple category starts and a children’s race, with the awards ceremony at 14:30.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run București is an untimed 5-kilometer race, known as the “Happiest 5k on the Planet,” celebrating health, joy, and originality through a colorful, energetic experience. Participants run, dance, and enjoy a festival atmosphere, getting covered in powder at every kilometer. The event ends with a vibrant party, where all runners are covered in colors and receive medals and temporary tattoos. It is a celebration of movement and community, open to all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km, untimed course
Powder color stations at every kilometer
Post-race party with a cloud of colored powder and music
additional: The event has several consecutive start waves, five minutes apart. Entry to the event area requires a race number and the T-shirt from the race kit. The participation kit includes a T-shirt, race number, temporary tattoos, bandana, medal, and colored powder. There is no baggage storage area. Children aged 0–6 can enter for free with a race number, medal, and powder, but without a T-shirt.

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Forest near Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a trail-running race of moderate difficulty, held in the deciduous forest near the town of Marghita. The event is organized by Run For Freedom Sports Club together with XTERRA Sport Bihor Sports Club and offers four routes suited to different levels of runners: Half Marathon (21.6 km), Cross (10.8 km), Speedy (5.4 km), and Mini (1 km). The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are appropriately marked for participants’ safety. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes on marked forest roads in the deciduous forest of Marghita
Moderate elevation gain: +460 m for the half marathon, +230 m for the cross, +20 m for the mini
Start and finish at Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through the race. Participants under 18 must provide a medical certificate and written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizers may exclude participants who are intoxicated or do not have appropriate equipment. Registration is exclusively through the official webshop.

name: Semimaraton Iași
organizer: Rotary Club Iași Copou, Salvați Copiii Iași, Primăria Municipiului Iași
description: Iași Half Marathon is the largest running event in northeastern Romania, held annually in the Palace of Culture Square. The half-marathon course consists of two loops that pass through the start area, giving runners a unique experience on the city’s main streets, with road traffic stopped and refreshment points along the way. The event has a strong charitable component, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds through educational and social projects. Taking part in the half-marathon, cross-country races and fun runs is an opportunity to do good and join a community committed to positive change.
course_highlights: Route along main streets with road traffic stopped
Passes in front of the Palace of Culture
Refreshment points for hydration and medical assistance
additional: Participants in the half-marathon, 10 km cross-country and 5 km cross-country races receive a disposable timing chip and a technical event T-shirt. Registration is available online until the deadline; after that, subject to availability, participants can register in person at the Iași Half Marathon kiosk in Palas Mall. Registration is not available on race day. The event provides an ambulance for medical assistance and plenty of photos at the finish and along the course. Participation includes hydration points, medical assistance, a race kit, and the option to participate online or in person. The event is charitable, supporting projects for disadvantaged children.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon
description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță brings runners to the streets of Bucharest in a race initiated by Olympic marathon champion Constantina Diță. The event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, open to both competitive and amateur runners. The course is flat and fast, suitable for those aiming for a good result or wanting to enjoy a run in the capital.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Running on the streets of Bucharest
Half marathon and 10 km races
additional: Individual, family, and friends registrations are mentioned, as well as the Team 3 Challenge.

name: URME PE PLAY
description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains. The routes are marked and include natural trails, forest roads, and paved roads, offering an authentic foothill experience. The event is open to both adults and children, with races for each age group. Participants can enjoy picturesque scenery and the friendly atmosphere of the local community at an event that combines sport with local culture and tradition.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 is an outdoor running competition held in the commune of Sălciua, situated between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, offering spectacular views. The event brings together people passionate about running, nature, culture, and fun, providing an opportunity to get away from everyday life and enjoy the beauty of nature in the company of loved ones. The competition includes four races: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m), open to all participants who meet the age and registration requirements. The organizers provide a complete experience, with race kits, an awards ceremony, and themed workshops for all ages.

name: Chindia City Race
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional run held in the heart of the Târgoviște Fortress, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place in Tricolorului Square and brings together participants of all ages in a festive atmosphere of friendly competition. The race starts at 10:00 and celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic urban course steeped in tradition.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este is a trail running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, in a wooded, hilly area known as “Világlátó.” Participants can run or take part in Nordic walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, aiming to complete as many 1.6 km laps as possible, each with 60 m of elevation gain. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, with a pleasant atmosphere, music, and an on-site bar. It’s a great opportunity for runners and others to test themselves in a friendly natural setting.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place at night and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances of 4 km and 10 km
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked routes, the option to register online, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon
description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 75 km, Maraton, 40 km, 23 km, Semimaraton, 4 km
description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Thermal Trail Race 2026
description: Thermal Trail Race is a trail running competition held in Betfia / Băile 1 Mai, along the scenic forest trails in the area. The event offers two races, one of 14 km and one of 7 km, suitable for different age categories and experience levels. The courses are well marked and offer a sporting experience in nature, with prizes for the top competitors. Participants receive electronic timing and an official event T-shirt.

name: Trascău Trail Run ~ 2026
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race, set amid the picturesque landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. The routes pass spectacular places such as Piatra Secuiului, Colțești Fortress, Plaiului Gorges, and Huda lui Papară Cave, offering a mountain-running experience with significant elevation changes and impressive views. The event is organized by the Green & Wild Association and emphasizes adventure in nature and local heritage. Participants benefit from hydration and refreshment stations, medals, and prizes. Registration is limited and takes place online.

name: Ciudanovita in Miscare 2026
description: Ciudanovița in Motion is an event dedicated to promoting health, nature, and community, organized in the commune of Ciudanovița. The event takes place outdoors, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural scenery and spend active time with the local community. It is an open invitation to everyone who wants to combine exercise with socializing and appreciating the surrounding environment.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
location: Bistra Mureșului, Deda, Mureș County, Romania

name: TRAILRUN IN TARA NASAUDULUI
location: Valea Caselor, Năsăud, Bistrița-Năsăud County, Romania
description: Trail Run in Țara Năsăudului is a trail-running event for all age groups and experience levels, held around Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Participants can choose from three marked and signposted routes featuring mixed terrain, climbs and descents, adapted for children, families and experienced runners. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a connection with nature, offering a supportive atmosphere focused on socializing and fair play. After the race, the fun continues with an afterparty and stories from the trails.
course_highlights: Marked and signposted routes with climbs, descents and mixed terrain
Picturesque scenery and spectacular views of the hills around Năsăud
Start and finish at Casuțele din Plai, with organized minibus transport from the parking area by the Năsăud town chapel
additional: Participants in the 10K Challenge receive the official T-shirt and a participation medal, while first-place winners in the 10K Challenge also receive two nights’ accommodation at Casuțele din Plai. The 2K route is intended for children and families and is approximately 1,700 metres long. Cars are not permitted at the start; transport is provided by minibus from the meeting point. After the race, there is a socializing area, a podcast, a BBQ and a chill zone.

name: Wings for Life World App Run : Oradea
location: Timișoara, Sibiu, Brașov, and București, Romania
description: Wings for Life World Run is a global running event in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running ahead of a pursuing vehicle called the Catcher Car. There is no fixed finish line; runners keep going until they are caught by the Catcher Car. All entry fees are donated to spinal cord injury research, supporting a worthy cause. The event is open to everyone, regardless of fitness level, and promotes solidarity and support for those who cannot run.
course_highlights: A simultaneous worldwide start for all participants
No fixed finish line; runners are pursued by the Catcher Car
100% of entry fees are donated to spinal cord injury research
additional: The event includes participation via a mobile app (App Run), which lets you run anywhere. The Catcher Car begins its pursuit 30 minutes after the start. The event is open to runners, wheelchair participants, and beginners. The app also offers audio support for an enhanced race experience.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon is a running race that takes you through the heart of Transylvania, crossing the center of Târgu Mureș and its prominent tourist attractions. The event offers a variety of races: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 4×5 km relay, and a children’s race, all starting and finishing in the central area, ideal for support from family and friends. Participants receive medals, prizes, and a complete kit with a T-shirt, race number, and timing chip. It is a vibrant spring experience that marks the start of the running season in Mureș.
course_highlights: Routes through the center of Târgu Mureș and its prominent tourist attractions
Start and finish in Piața Teatrului, in the city center
A variety of events: half marathon 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4×5 km relay, and children’s race
additional: The entry package includes an official T-shirt, race number, single-use timing chip, finisher’s medal, sponsors’ brochures, diplomas downloadable online, official photos, and access to hydration and refreshment points. The T-shirt size is selected during registration but may vary depending on the manufacturer. Sportswear is mandatory, and the race number must be visible throughout the race.

name: Crosul T.E.A.M.
description: The T.E.A.M. Run is a charity sporting event held in Timișoara, combining exercise with solidarity to support the children cared for by the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association. The event is participatory, with no timing or rankings, and offers an enjoyable experience for all ages, with races for babies, children, and adults. The routes pass through central areas of the city, and the funds raised support the “Casa InimiiLor” project, a therapeutic refuge for children. Taking part is an expression of solidarity and hope for those in need.

name: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026
description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 is a 5-kilometer race full of positive energy, color, and fun, perfect for all ages and fitness levels. The event is untimed, focusing on the joy of running and the vibrant experience of colors applied at every kilometer. The urban route starts and finishes in Piața Unirii, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple successive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the finish. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu is a leading mountain running event in Romania, held in Moieciu de Sus. The competition includes Marathon, Half Marathon and Cross Country races, as well as a children’s race, EcoKids. The courses are made up of 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic running experience in nature, with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. The event promotes sustainable practices and takes place annually in May, bringing together runners of all levels.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge is a trail running event held on marked paths in Turnu Roșu and on the hills at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a spectacular natural setting and a challenge for all fitness levels. The event includes three races: a 21 km half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each suited to different types of participants, from experienced athletes to those seeking a more relaxed experience. The organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socializing, offering facilities such as stretching sessions, post-run massage, camping, and activities for children. It’s an excellent opportunity to enjoy nature, sport, and community in Sibiu County.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: The Suceava Citadels Cross-Country Run is a popular running event held in the city of Suceava, offering participants an outdoor sporting experience with routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels. The event includes children’s races, a popular race, and a cross-country race, promoting exercise and community spirit. Participants can run along routes passing through historic and picturesque areas, surrounded by citadels and local scenery. The organizers provide a participation kit and prizes for competitors, encouraging involvement and athletic performance.

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills is a mountain running race organized in Crasna, Sălaj County. The event invites running enthusiasts to explore the area’s picturesque hills, offering a sporting experience in nature. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy beautiful scenery and a friendly atmosphere.

name: SEMIMARATON FETESTI
description: The Fetești Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings together runners from the region for races of various distances, including a half marathon and cross-country races. The organizers, the Feteștiul Aleargă Sports Association, promote sport and health in the community, offering an enjoyable and competitive experience. The event has a tradition in the area and takes place on varied routes suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Timotion
price_range: Participație între 75 RON și 1.200 RON, în funcție de cursă

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Timotion is the largest charitable sporting event in western Romania, bringing together thousands of participants, volunteers, and supporters each year to run, cycle, and do good for the community. The event offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels, from cycling and a half marathon to children’s races and fun races on wheels. By taking part, runners and cyclists support community projects and help foster solidarity and hope in the region. Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.
course_highlights: The timed 15 km SMW cycling race is for experienced participants
A 21 km half marathon and 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km fun runs for various age categories
Special races for children and fun races on wheels, also accessible to people with reduced mobility
additional: Races are timed and have specific time limits; children’s races require a legal guardian to accompany participants; the cycling race is for non-electric bicycles; accessible races are available for people with reduced mobility; races take place on Bd. Ion C. Brătianu; races start in waves between 08:00 and 17:30. Multiple races on May 10, including cycling, a half marathon, and recreational races; fundraising component; volunteering opportunities

name: SEMIMARATONUL SIRETULUI In memoriam Ilie Roșu
location: Adjudu Vechi, Adjud, Vrancea County, Romania
description: The Siret Half Marathon – In Memoriam Ilie Roșu is a running race held in Adjudu Vechi, Vrancea County, in memory of marathon runner Ilie Roșu. The half marathon invites runners to take part in a competition dedicated to running and remembrance. The start is announced at the church in Adjudu Vechi.
course_highlights: Start near the church in Adjudu Vechi.
Half marathon held in the Adjud area, in Vrancea County.
Race held in memory of marathon runner Ilie Roșu.
additional: The start is scheduled for 9:00.

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition testing strength, speed, agility, and skills, held in Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition challenges participants to push their limits on an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to suit both experienced runners and those looking for a shorter challenge.

name: Crosul Sport4All
description: Sport 4 All Cross-Country Run is an annual running event held in Lugoj, open to all ages and fitness levels. The event features untimed races for children and a 2 km fun run, as well as timed 4 km and 6 km races for older participants. The routes are loops around the Drăgan European University and along the city’s central streets, offering a pleasant urban experience. Participants receive finisher medals, and the timed races have age categories. The event is supported by Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University, with 400 free places provided by sponsor Mondial S.A.

name: MARATONUL NISIPULUI Run&Fun
description: The Maratonul Nisipului Run & Fun, held at Zoom Beach in Constanța, is a sporting event that combines competition with fun and promotes a healthy lifestyle. The event offers six different races, from the 42 km marathon to recreational runs for the whole family, held on the sands of the Romanian coast. Participants can enjoy spectacular routes with the sea breeze, in an energetic, welcoming community atmosphere. The marathon is a celebration of movement, nature, and adventure, welcoming both professional and amateur runners.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is Romania’s largest cross-country cycling marathon, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, covering approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no major elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere—ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation changes and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own difficulties and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and determination, and after the race, participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including small fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a mud trench, a wall crossing, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a difficult OCR. The event includes different distance categories and courses and is open to both recreational and advanced runners.

name: Bârlad Hills Challenge ~ 2027
location: Cotu Negru, Bârlad, Vaslui County, Romania

name: Jidvei Weinland Trails - Running Edition ~ 2027
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba County, Romania

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Bethlen-Haller Castle, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba County, Romania
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the Bethlen-Haller Castle estate, in the heart of Transylvania. The competition combines running and cycling on spectacular routes through vineyards and ancient forests, offering participants an authentic experience in Wine Country. The event includes races for all fitness levels, activities for children, and food and wine experiences, creating a memorable day for athletes and their companions alike. It is a celebration of sport, nature, and local culture, with a strong community spirit and support for cultural projects.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through the vineyards and forests of the Bethlen-Haller Castle estate
Stunning scenery in the heart of Transylvania, with varied routes for all fitness levels
The event includes trail races, MTB/XCM marathons, and children’s races, all set amid nature and local culture
additional: The event includes special activities for children, with games and creative workshops in a safe setting. Food and wine experiences and tours of Bethlen-Haller Castle and the Jidvei Winery are available for an additional fee. The MTB race offers family-team options and non-competitive E-BIKE races. Special prizes are awarded to the youngest runners in the 1 km and 2 km races.

name: Obciniada Night Run
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night-running competition in Bucovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere under the stars. Participants can choose from several races, from a half marathon to children’s races, all held on mountain trails with impressive scenery. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and local community involvement, and is organized to support the education of disadvantaged children. Participants benefit from chip timing, cash prizes, access to hydration stations, and a hot meal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with significant elevation gain (up to 1050m for the half marathon)
Checkpoints and aid stations along the route, including at Vârful Toaca
Festival atmosphere with general admission and related activities
additional: Online registration closes Thursday at 18:00, and on-site registration is available until Saturday at 20:00. Participants are required to carry specific equipment. Live rankings and an electronic certificate are provided. Cash prizes will be announced at the beginning of 2027. Participants receive a wristband granting access to the festival area and a hot meal at the finish.

name: Tour de Tur
location: Complex Mujdeni, Lacul Mujdeni, Orașu Nou, Satu Mare County, Romania
description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the area of Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers varied courses for all fitness levels, from short, recreational races to more demanding endurance events. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and a friendly atmosphere, and are warmly invited to take part in the competition’s 20th edition. The organizers emphasize safety and compliance with the rules specific to each event. Tour de Tur is an excellent opportunity for nature and sports enthusiasts to meet and compete in a remarkable natural setting.
course_highlights: Varied mountain bike courses: Fun Ride (13 km, 385 m elevation gain), Race (34 km, 930 m elevation gain), Marathon (44 km, 1,180 m elevation gain)
Trail running courses: Fun Run (6 km, 184 m elevation gain), Cross (12 km, 390 m elevation gain), Half Marathon (25 km, 990 m elevation gain)
The event takes place at Lake Mujdeni, providing a picturesque natural setting for the competition
additional: The event includes several categories and distances for both mountain biking and trail running, with varying elevation gains. The organizer is the Transylvanian Carpathian Society - Satu Mare. The exact location is Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. Contact phone: +40-743-419443.

name: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru
description: Casa Bună Sânpetru Half Marathon is a charity sporting event that gives participants the opportunity to run on varied and scenic routes in the Sânpetru area of Brașov. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, flawless organization, and support for disadvantaged families through Casa Bună Sânpetru. The routes offer different levels of difficulty, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with beautiful scenery and sporting challenges. Taking part in this half marathon means not only enjoying a sporting experience, but also supporting a noble cause.

name: Semimaraton Galați
distance_verbose: Semimaraton, 10.5 km, 3000 metri, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.4 km
description: Semimaraton Galați is a philanthropic sporting event that combines athletic performance with social responsibility, bringing together professional and amateur runners, families, and volunteers. For more than 12 editions, the event has supported local community causes through entry fees and donations, funding projects focused on education, health, and social inclusion. The varied courses and community atmosphere make Semimaraton Galați a unique experience that brings sport closer to the community and promotes solidarity. The 2026 edition continues this tradition, offering races for all ages and fitness levels.

name: Crosul Copiilor
description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 is a competition for children aged 0 to 14, held in Central Park in Baia Mare. The event offers races tailored to different age groups, from the Baby Run for children under 4 to timed competitive races for the older groups. It’s a race full of energy and joy, with parents cheering on the children. Every child is encouraged to take part and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km through mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra runners. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as the Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognized, offers iTRA points and has been voted one of the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route through mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green meadows and the authentic sounds of bells and flowing water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: The event awards 3 iTRA points to finishers. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including barbecue with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, offers iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultra-marathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognized as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity, and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have previous mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridges
Start and finish in the Bran Castle area
additional: Participation limits apply, and previous experience is mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for the winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania
description: The Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their registration fee. The event includes multiple races for all ages and levels, from a full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Piața Mare and surrounding areas. It is a movement that brings communities together and inspires them, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Piața Mare, Sibiu
Philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Registration fees are considered donations to support community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay race.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a mix of narrow paths, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, providing a unique experience for runners passionate about the mountains. The races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special souvenirs for those who finish within the time limits.

A growing local tradition, it brings athletes and supporters together for a memorable experience.

The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12

The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

name: Thermal Trail Race
location: Băile 1 Mai, Sânmartin, Bihor County, Romania

Two races are available: the 14 km Cross and the 7 km Mini, offering a trail-running experience amid the natural scenery of the capital of thermal waters.
