name: Macin Mountain Fun ~ 2026
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is a mountain cycling and running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Măcin Mountains. The courses offer a range of difficulty levels, from technical and demanding routes for experienced cyclists to more accessible trails for amateurs. The event emphasizes safety, fair play, and fun, making it suitable for outdoor sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and athletic challenges. Registration is online, and the organizers provide a well-organized, friendly experience.

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with refreshment stations providing still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruit, and energy bars. Participants receive a race pack containing a personalized technical T-shirt, a race number, and an electronic chip for timing. Medical assistance is provided along the course by ambulances and specialized staff. Race pack collection takes place between 16:00 and 20:00.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Refreshment stations with drinks and energy snacks
Medical assistance along the course, with ambulances and specialized staff
additional: The race pack includes an official personalized technical T-shirt, a race number, and an electronic chip for timing. Medical assistance is provided by specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the course. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and their identity card or passport.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: The race kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a disposable chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: AROBS X-Man Romania 2026
description: The AROBS X-Man Romania 2026 competition invites competitors from Romania and abroad, amateurs and professionals alike, to test their limits over the Long, Middle and Olympic distances. The event takes place in Oradea, a vibrant Art Nouveau city with a rich cultural and architectural history. Participants can enjoy a unique urban setting, with numerous tourist attractions and modern amenities. The organizers offer attractive prizes to reward each participant’s determination and passion.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
description: Maraton Apuseni is an iconic mountain-running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering a variety of routes for all preferences and experience levels. Participants can choose between an ultramarathon, marathon, half-marathon, cross-country race, and family race, enjoying picturesque scenery, shaded trails, spectacular ridges, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is organized by the Romanian Alpine Club, Cluj Branch, with a friendly, festive atmosphere. It is a unique opportunity to run in nature, test your limits, and connect with other mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: Măcin Mountain Fun
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is an event for mountain biking and running enthusiasts, held amid the natural beauty of the Greci area, Tulcea County. The courses offer technical challenges and spectacular scenery, and are suitable both for experienced competitors and for those looking to enjoy an active outdoor experience. The event promotes fair play and participant safety, offering a variety of courses, from easy to difficult and technical. It is an excellent opportunity to combine sport, nature, and socializing in a friendly setting.
course_highlights: The 54 km long course with 1,700 m of elevation gain is difficult and technical, with spectacular climbs and descents
The 32 km short course with 600 m of elevation gain has easy-to-moderate technical difficulty, featuring an approximately 6 km climb and a long 9 km descent
The 23 km half-marathon course is technical and difficult, while the 12 km cross-country course is easy to moderate and suited to runners accustomed to varied terrain
additional: Registration is confirmed after the fee is paid, within a maximum of 5 calendar days. Payment can be made by card, bank transfer, or at a BCR branch counter. Participants under 18 must have written consent from their parents and submit a liability waiver on race day. T-shirts come in fixed sizes and cannot be exchanged. The courses are available for download in .zip format.

name: Festivalul Sporturilor Iași
description: Iași Sports Festival is a sporting event for everyone, from beginners to advanced competitors, offering a variety of events such as trail running, mountain biking, orienteering, and road running. The event takes place on routes in the city of Iași and the surrounding areas, with starts and finishes at Hotel La Castel and the Palace of Culture. Participants can compete individually or in multiple events to receive discounts, and can take on the Multisport Trophy challenge, which includes four events over two days. The festival promotes physical activity for everyone, including families and people with special abilities, offering a complete and welcoming experience.
course_highlights: Varied routes in the city of Iași and surrounding areas, including trails through vineyards and Breazu Forest
Aid and hydration stations along the trail-running routes
Live electronic timing and cash prizes in the Open categories

The competition takes place regardless of weather conditions, except in extreme conditions. Timing is chip-free, and the standings are available live on the website during the race. There are Open categories with cash prizes and age categories detailed in the regulations. Time limits for events: 11 km trail run - 2 hours; 21 km half marathon - 3 hours.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: Maraton Apuseni is a mountain running event offering varied courses for all fitness levels, set amid the picturesque landscapes of the Apuseni Mountains. Participants can choose from an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and family events, running through dense forests, spectacular ridgelines, and traditional villages. The event is held annually at Buscat Resort, Cluj, and emphasizes an authentic nature experience with a festival atmosphere. The courses are carefully marked and equipped with aid stations, and each runner receives a participation kit with official gear and other benefits.
course_highlights: Courses through the dense forests and spectacular ridgelines of the Apuseni Mountains
Passing through the Scărița-Belioara Nature Reserve and the alpine area of Muntele Mare
Courses that include traditional villages and alpine meadows
additional: The participation kit includes official gear, a timing chip, a race bib, a finisher’s medal, access to aid stations and the afterparty, as well as energy drinks depending on the event. The ultramarathon has specific mandatory gear, and the courses are carefully marked and equipped with aid stations. There is a No Limits event dedicated to people with disabilities. The ultramarathon starts at 05:00, and cutoff times are set for checkpoints along the course.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026

The event offers three challenging courses suitable for runners of all levels, with a friendly atmosphere and a community passionate about exercise. The event’s motto encourages competitors to run beyond their own limits and enjoy the course. The event is carefully organized, and participation also supports a charitable cause.

The half-marathon and 12 km race start in Constantin Poroineanu Park, near the 1848 Monument
The half-marathon course is approximately 22.9 km long

The contribution must be paid by bank transfer within 3 business days of registration; failure to pay will result in cancellation of the registration. The half-marathon and 12 km race share a start in Constantin Poroineanu Park, near the 1848 Monument.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross is a running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Tinca Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes 5 km and 10 km cross-country races, suitable for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The course starts at Tinca Community Stadium and follows a 2.5 km loop through the forest next to the stadium, finishing at the stadium. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian. Cash prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top finishers.

name: SepsiRun
description: SepsiRun is a running festival held in the city of Sfântu Gheorghe and its surroundings. Its goal is to become the largest running event in the area, attracting over 1,000 participants from across the country. The event features several races on urban and trail routes, suitable for all experience levels, with distances ranging from 5 km to 23 km. SepsiRun offers a complete running experience, combining nature and the city with varied routes and a welcoming atmosphere for runners.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026

With a variety of races for all ages and ability levels, Pedală în Bănie promotes health, community spirit, and environmental protection, offering a complete experience of competition and adventure in nature. Its friendly atmosphere and thoughtful organization make it a celebration of sport and outdoor activity.

A variety of races: marathon, trail, and MTB
Natural landscapes and authentic local communities

The organizer will decide whether race-day registrations will be allowed and will announce this in advance. Spectacular routes, outdoor event, community participation

name: Retezat Sky Race

Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race offers a passionate community and opportunities to connect with others and push personal limits. Participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of the Retezat Mountains.

name: Maraton Maramureș

The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.

Multiple checkpoints, hydration stations, and refreshment points along the route

name: The Color Run Iași
description: The Color Run Iași is an untimed 5-kilometer race, known as the “Happiest 5k on the Planet,” celebrating health, joy, and originality through a colorful, high-energy experience. Participants run, dance, and enjoy a festive atmosphere, getting covered in vibrant powder at every kilometer. The event is open to all ages and promotes an active, fun lifestyle, culminating in a colorful post-race party. The Color Run is a celebration of community and movement, offering a memorable day for all participants.
course_highlights: Untimed 5 km race with colored powder at every kilometer
Festive atmosphere with music and a post-race party featuring a cloud of colored powder
Open to all ages, with no minimum or maximum age limit
additional: Children aged 0 to 6 can participate for free and receive a race bib, medal, and colored powder, but must be accompanied by an adult. The standard kit includes a T-shirt, race bib, temporary tattoos, bandana, medal, and colored powder. Participants with disabilities and their companions receive free access in accordance with the law. Registration is online, and the entry fee varies depending on the registration period. The event promotes respect for the environment and sportsmanship throughout the race.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is a nature running event held on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event combines physical effort with a profound message about living life to the fullest in body, mind, and spirit. It is for those seeking more than a competition: an authentic experience that brings people together and points them toward Christ. The name Peniel means “place of meeting,” symbolizing a living connection with God and personal transformation. The routes offer a varied, runnable, and beautiful experience, suitable for both beginners and advanced runners.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route (21 km) has approximately 650 m of elevation gain, shares sections with the 10 km route, and includes a scenic loop in the Tărpiu area.
The 10 km route is fast, easy, and very runnable, with approximately 270 m of elevation gain, on a route rarely used for competitions.
The accessible 5 km route has two short climbs, including one through a fir forest, and is suitable for beginners and competitive runners.
additional: The event includes a Kids Cross race for children, promoting fun and exercise for the little ones. The official event T-shirt is provided to participants. Routes may undergo minor changes before the event, and the organizers promote a healthy, balanced lifestyle centered on community and faith.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes suited to all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Event part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee went to the Via Transilvanica project by the Tășuleasa Social Association.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is the largest multisport event in Romania, held in Cluj-Napoca. The festival combines sports competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. Crosul Supereroilor, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, motivating participants to run for a social cause in support of the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, supporters, and sports enthusiasts in a festive and welcoming setting.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy an outdoor ride or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully prepared to protect the natural environment, and course markings will be kept to a minimum to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a backup date.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race that brings together runners of all ages and their families, including pets, to support free psychotherapy services. The event takes place in Herăstrău Park in Bucharest and offers accessible, dynamic courses suitable for amateurs, families, and people with disabilities. Participants receive superhero costumes and themed kits, and every kilometer run contributes to a noble cause. The atmosphere is full of energy, fun, and community solidarity.
course_highlights: Flat, fully marked urban courses suitable for runners of all levels
A special course accessible to people with disabilities
Pets are welcome, with dedicated areas for families and children
additional: Participants receive the official T-shirt, a superhero cape, themed accessories, a surprise bag, a race number, and a medal. Hydration stations, medical assistance, security, and secure baggage storage are provided. The event includes prizes for the top 3 finishers in the 7 km and 3 km races.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sports, eco and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition in 2026 celebrates the area’s nature, history and cultural heritage, offering varied routes for runners of all levels. The event includes marathon, half-marathon, cross-country and children’s races, on routes combining mountain trails, local roads and sections of paved road. Along the way, participants can admire natural landscapes and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes along mountain trails and local roads
A combination of mountain and road running
Natural landscapes and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The program also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are suitable for both mountain runners and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both mountain runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Children’s Race, which follows age-group routes in the historic center of the village. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.

name: Crosul Hoia
description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race takes place in June, swapping urban asphalt for nature and offering an outdoor running experience.

name: Urlea Super Vertical
description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme and innovative mountain race held in the Breaza area of the Făgăraș Mountains. It is Romania’s most challenging vertical race, covering a distance of 12 km with 1,833 m of elevation gain and reaching an altitude of 2,474 m. Its unique format includes an up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs and the other descends, offering an intense and spectacular experience. The race focuses on vertical adrenaline and mountain spectacle, and is a first for Romanian mountain running.
course_highlights: 12 km with 1,833 m of elevation gain, reaching an altitude of 2,474 m
UP + DOWN relay format, with one partner climbing and the other descending
Route along a forest road and logging road, through deciduous and coniferous forests, and across alpine pasture
additional: Payment is accepted exclusively by bank card, and registration is valid only after full payment. Participants receive a personalized race bib (those who register after 15 July receive a non-personalized bib). Engraved stone finisher medals and an HG superlight technical T-shirt are provided to the first 300 registrants. Aid and hydration stations along the route, a hot meal on the route, medical assistance, photo albums with selfie identification, parking for 360 cars, and Q&A sessions and themed workshops are provided.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: The Târnava Marathon is a trail running event held in Târnăveni, Mureș County, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon offers an outdoor experience surrounded by the natural landscapes of the Transylvania region. The start and finish take place on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition includes several running routes for all ages and fitness levels. The event brings together a community of passionate athletes and supports environmental education and the benefits of running in nature.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare
A variety of trail running routes: half marathon 21 km, cross-country 10 km, cross-country 4 km, and Kids Trail Running
Natural landscapes in the Transylvania region, in Mureș County
additional: Race kits can be picked up the day before the event between 18:00 and 21:00 and on race day between 07:00 and 09:30. A fitness instructor leads a warm-up before the start. Races for children are organized by age group. After the competition, there is a Goulash Party, a concert, and the awards ceremony.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with substantial elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The routes are marked and have hydration points, and the finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, the event’s main partner. Participants receive a race kit with a race bib, a T-shirt (if registered by June 2), a medal, access to refreshment points, and medical assistance.
course_highlights: Cross route: 14 km with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain, featuring sustained climbs and technical descents
Half Marathon route: approx. 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain, for an extra challenge
Hydration points are set up along the routes (2 for the Cross, 4 for the Half Marathon)
additional: The start is at Podul Berdu, in the Ferneziu neighborhood, at the foot of Lake Firiza, accessible by bus no. 1. The race kit includes a chip-timed bib, a T-shirt (available only until June 2), a medal, access to refreshment points, and medical assistance. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl. The routes are marked with ribbons and arrows.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodna Mountains, near Borșa, Maramureș. The event offers three distinct routes suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor route, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău route, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta route, a fast course with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and emphasizes the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to take part in an active weekend outdoors.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through scenic areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, giving runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a bib, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children at the starting line. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the city’s energy, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from 3-year-old children to 78-year-old seniors, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes, as well as special races for the little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations, and artistic performances, offering a day dedicated to health, community, and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania, and UHU Romania.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
description: The Mioveni City Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus Romania, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in and support the values of honor and respect in a friendly and motivating setting.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 102 km, 58 km, 57 km, 45 km, 44 km, 36 km, 23 km, 6 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race held at Complex Cheile Grădiștei in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and Piatra Craiului. The event offers six individual race options, with distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature, in a friendly and well-organized setting. Registration is limited and takes place online.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
A range of distances from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: Registration is limited and can be completed online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by donations from participants, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation requires an online form; registration is limited, and wildcards may be available to recognized athletes.

name: Carpathia Trails ~ 2027
distance_verbose: 102 km, 57 km, 45 km, 36 km, 23 km, 6 km

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the Călimănești-Căciulata spa resort. The event, organized by the Pegas Triathlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require experience and mountain skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.

name: Siriu Open Water JOY ~ 2027
location: Barajul Siriu, Siriu, Buzău County, Romania

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, Bacău, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira massif. Participants can choose between a half marathon and a cross-country race, both featuring significant elevation gain and well-marked routes. The event emphasizes the mountain experience and promotes active tourism and ecotourism in the area, amid beautiful, unspoiled nature. The event is praised for its clear markings, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through shady forests and alpine areas with unspoiled natural scenery
Approximately 25 km half marathon with 1,100 m of positive elevation gain
Approximately 14 km cross-country race with 700 m of positive elevation gain, including sections of asphalt and runnable forest road
additional: The routes are marked 90% with hiking trail markings, supplemented by plastic tape and signs where needed. Participants should have mountain experience and be prepared for difficult sections, including passages with fixed ropes. The start is in the Central Park of the Slănic Moldova resort. The organizers recommend booking accommodation early, as the resort has limited capacity during peak season.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 series and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to challenging mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain course with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km course suitable for beginner and intermediate runners, through forests and rolling hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, challenging climb
additional: The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, and the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA series is conditional on holding a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The courses are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, providing a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, and is a great opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including over 500 m of elevation gain in 4 km on K24
Spectacular views from Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. Routes are marked with yellow tape featuring the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cutoff times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can enter various race categories, and the event supports a social cause. Details about registration and rules are available on the official website.

name: Crosul Aleargă TU pentru EI powered by Flashnet – CURSA VIRTUALA ~ 2027
ALEARGĂ TU PENTRU EI by HOSPICE Casa Sperantei
distance_verbose: 20 km, 18 km, 10 km, 6 km, 4 km, 2 km, 0.9 km
description: “Run YOU for Them” is a running event organized by HOSPICE Casa Speranței in Brașov to support the organization’s work. Previous editions have featured races for different ability levels, from short races for children and beginners to distances of 20 km. The 2027 event is scheduled for July 11 in the Aleea Tiberiu Brediceanu area.
course_highlights: Located in the Aleea Tiberiu Brediceanu area of Brașov
Previous editions offered distances from 900 m to 20 km
Charity event organized by HOSPICE Casa Speranței
additional: Previous editions have included races of 900 m, 2 km, 4 km, 6 km, 10 km, 18 km, and 20 km.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Cursa Dochia, with approximately 1,500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Cursa Bate Toaca, with approximately 2,700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport fără Limite Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place in the village of Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain courses of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running event held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation changes, for adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of mountain cultural heritage in the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains area.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness areas. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval sheepfolds, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometre offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race held in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running along routes through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the starting line is provided by coach. Race kits can be picked up on Saturday and Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic and energizing experience for runners of all levels.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail-running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through forest, clearly marked during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for exercising in nature.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor run in an urban natural setting, ideal for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation for taking up running and encourage community involvement.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition held at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to an Everesting. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until places are filled.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with routes climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to a nearly 40 km Marathon with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The routes cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of the Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term plan for continuity.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting, and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event features marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local personalities, offering an outdoor experience on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the welcoming community atmosphere. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.

name: Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail
description: The Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail is a trail-running race held in northern Romania, offering participants an authentic experience amid spectacular scenery. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, bringing together passionate runners in a remarkable natural setting. The routes are designed to showcase the beauty of the area and the spirit of northern Romania.

name: Ultra Race Romania
description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route through the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary scenery and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event focuses on the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.

name: THE COLOR RUN - MAMAIA BY NIGHT
description: The Color Run - Mamaia by Night is a colorful, energetic 5-kilometer race along a route in Mamaia, near the large parking area in front of the Rex Hotel. The event celebrates health, joy, and originality. Participants are showered with fluorescent powder at every kilometer, and the fun continues with a cloud of colored powder at the finish. The race is untimed, focusing on a joyful experience and a festival atmosphere with music and interactive activities. Suitable for all ages, including young children, it promises a memorable evening of running and outdoor fun.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique outdoor running experience on specially prepared trails, surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running together as a community.

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is Romania’s most beautiful night cross-country race, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked routes after dark. Races are available for adults over distances of 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children over distances of 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age groups from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the winners of the open category in the 9 km race.

name: 2X2 Race
location: Lacul Bâlea, Transfăgărășan, Sibiu County, Romania
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m elevation gain) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m elevation gain), are also highly technical and intense, and intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event that celebrates Romania’s nature and unique heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a challenge of 39.3 km with an elevation gain of 1,292 m, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere, with well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run repeated 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-focused experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. Organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului, the event continues the local tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular trails in the heart of nature, at the meeting point of Retezat and Domogled–Valea Cernei National Parks. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with challenging routes and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children’s race, as well as related social and cultural activities.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, around the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the area's tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits, and related activities such as tastings and socializing.

name: Aventura în Vrancea Sălbatică
location: Putna-Vrancea Natural Park, Vrancea County, Romania

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic experience in nature for runners of all levels. The race features two main events: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both take place on varied, unpaved routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with support from Păulești City Hall, and promotes respect for the wilderness and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting wildlife rehabilitation in Romania.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing the connections between participants and their shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.

name: Șopa Forest Race ~ 2027
location: Șopa Forest, Șelimbăr, Sibiu County, Romania

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Jud. Alba
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering events for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The courses are varied, with significant elevation changes, offering a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, welcoming both experienced runners and those looking to make the transition to ultramarathons. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.

name: StruguRUN
description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each following spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport with nature and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historical treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, with cash prizes and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.

name: CIUCAȘ X3 Scriem povestea. Împreună clădim tradiție.
organizer: Clubul de Turism și Alpinism Ciucaș Ploiești
description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A range of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a history spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied routes in a friendly atmosphere with professional organization.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships
description: The 2026 European Masters Off-Road Running Championships in Râșnov bring together masters athletes from across Europe to compete in the heart of the Carpathian Mountains. The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail-running course combined with Transylvania’s rich cultural heritage. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and scenic terrain.

name: Woodrocks Trail Run
description: Woodrocks Trail Run is a mountain running event held in the village of Petriș, offering three storybook courses for runners of all levels. The 6 km Green Course is ideal for beginners, with shady trails and gentle hills. The 15 km Blue Course offers an exhilarating experience with moderate climbs, while the 35 km Pink Course is a thrilling adventure with 1,600 metres of elevation gain over rugged terrain and scenic ridgelines. The event celebrates the joy of running in nature and supports environmental education through the EcoStuff Romania Association.

name: Maratonul Dragomirnei
description: The Dragomirna Marathon is an annual competition held in the Dragomirna Beech Forest Nature Reserve in Suceava. It offers a unique running experience in nature, combining scenic landscapes with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The event includes several races, from a full marathon to a half marathon and a cross-country race, catering to both experienced and amateur runners. Participants receive race kits and prizes, while the organizers promote an active community committed to supporting sport and the environment.

name: AIUD GREEN RUN by DP World
organizer: DP World, Primăria și Consiliul Local Aiud, Asociația Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesület
description: Aiud Green Run by DP World is a sporting event that promotes a healthy, eco-friendly lifestyle, giving participants the opportunity to run scenic routes surrounded by nature and authentic Transylvanian landscapes. The event includes a 21 km half marathon, an 8 km race, and a 2 km family run, suitable for all experience levels. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire runners while offering a friendly atmosphere and a memorable experience in the municipality of Aiud. The start is near Aiud Fortress, and the event is organized in partnership with Aiud City Hall and the Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesulet Association.

name: ORADEA RUN FEST
description: Oradea Run Fest returns for its second edition on September 12 in Piața Unirii, Oradea. The event promises an experience full of energy, movement and good cheer, bringing together people passionate about sport, health and community. The organizers are preparing a spectacular edition with surprises and special moments for participants.

name: Râșnov Medieval Run  ~ 2026
location: centrul orașului Râșnov, Râșnov, Brașov County, Romania
description: Râșnov Medieval Run is a running race held in the center of Râșnov, combining medieval spirit with a passion for running. The event offers participants a unique experience, with clear participation requirements, including presenting a medical certificate and wearing the race bib throughout the race. The start is scheduled for the morning, and the organizers provide facilities such as timing, first aid, and a dedicated start and finish area. It is a competition suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a special atmosphere and the picturesque scenery of Râșnov.
course_highlights: Route through the center of Râșnov
Unique medieval atmosphere
Timing and first-aid facilities provided
additional: Participants must bring an identity document when collecting their race kit. They must present a medical certificate or accept responsibility for their physical fitness. The race bib must be worn on the front of the shirt throughout the race, from start to finish. Participants must present identification and a medical certificate, and wear their race bib visibly. Registration is online, with on-site registration also possible while places remain.

name: Rombat Trail Run
description: Rombat Trail Run is a mountain running race that invites over 600 nature lovers to take part in the spectacular natural landscape of the Ghinzii and Codrișor forests. The event offers an authentic trail-running experience, combining athletic challenge with the beauty of the surrounding environment. Organized by Runners Club, this competition is for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and test their limits in a friendly, professional setting.

name: Zăvoi Trail Comana
description: Zăvoi Trail Comana is a sporting event for trail running and mountain biking enthusiasts, held in the heart of Comana Natural Park, a protected area with impressive biodiversity. The event is organized by the Plogging for Romania Association, which promotes sport and environmental protection through plogging activities. The routes offer an authentic nature-exploration experience, combining sporting challenges with awareness of the importance of protecting the local ecosystem. Participants can choose between mountain bike and trail running races, each featuring spectacular and accessible routes.

name: Baia Mare Half Marathon
organizer: Maramureș Runners, Rotary Club Baia Mare
description: The Baia Mare Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings together runners from across the country to celebrate movement, community, and an active lifestyle. The main race is the 21 km half marathon, held on an urban course consisting of 6 loops of 3.5 km each, for participants over the age of 15. The event also includes relay races, a 7 km cross-country race, a 3 km fun run, children’s races, and a special AutiSmile race dedicated to people with autism. The organizers emphasize health, community, and environmental protection, planting trees for every kilometer run.

name: Șiria Vertical Loop
description: Șiria Vertical Loop 2h is a short-duration mountain running competition for both amateurs and professionals, promoting the tourist heritage of Arad County, especially Șiria Fortress. The race follows a vertical-race course, with a 2.5 km loop and approximately 240 m of elevation gain per loop. The race lasts 2 hours. Participants must complete at least one full loop to be considered finishers. The race is known for its difficulty and the mental challenge it involves. The event is part of the A.T.I.A. Trail Trilogy and is included in the ITRA National League.

name: Gușterița Trail Run
description: Gușterița Trail Run (GTR) is a mountain running race held in Gușterița Forest in Sibiu, offering accessible and varied routes for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The routes cross a rich natural area, with dirt trails and spruce forests, offering an authentic trail-running experience close to the city. The event promotes both competition and community, bringing together mountain running enthusiasts in a spectacular natural setting. GTR is an ideal opportunity to push your limits and enjoy nature in the company of other runners.

name: Mogoșa Race
description: Mogoșa Race is an annual mountain running competition held in September, starting at Domeniul Mogoșa in Baia Sprie, Maramureș. The event offers a variety of courses, from 4 km for all participants, to an accessible and engaging 11 km route, and a 21 km half marathon for experienced runners, featuring demanding climbs and technical descents. The race promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the Mogoșa area in a vibrant, community atmosphere. It is organized by the Baia Mare în Mișcare Association, which supports physical activity and health in the community.

name: OMU MARATHON by Transilvania 100
description: OMU Marathon by Transilvania 100 is a challenging mountain race held in the Bucegi Mountains, finishing at the iconic Bran Castle. The main marathon covers 41 km with nearly 3,000 meters of elevation gain, traversing windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trails up to Vf Omu at 2,505 meters. The event also features two shorter races, SCARA Skyrace (24 km, 1,800 m climb) and POARTA Cross (11 km, 420 m climb), all offering breathtaking Transylvanian scenery and professional support from the experienced Transylvania 100 team. The race takes place in early October, promising a memorable late-summer mountain adventure.

name: Oradea City Running Day
description: Oradea City Running Day is an annual sporting event held in Oradea, offering running races for all ages and fitness levels. The courses include a half marathon, a corporate relay, a 10.5 km race, and a popular 5 km run, all held on an urban route marked with blue arrows that passes through notable areas of the city. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and team spirit, especially through the relay race dedicated to company employees. Participants receive race kits with an electronic chip and have access to refreshment points along the route.

name: Crosul Companiilor
description: The Crosul Companiilor powered by Emerson is the largest team-building event in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together employees from various companies for a race through the city streets. The event promotes team spirit and health through sport, offering participants an enjoyable and dynamic experience. The course is designed to be accessible and motivating, encouraging people to take part in teams and support their colleagues. The organizers, Runners Club, provide a friendly and professional atmosphere, with official partners and dedicated support.

name: Semimaraton Brăila
description: The Brăila Half Marathon is an annual race held along the riverfront and in Monument Park in Brăila, offering participants an enjoyable and accessible running experience. The event promotes solidarity by supporting local charitable causes, and runners can turn every kilometer into an act of support for the community. The course is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners, providing an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of Brăila in a friendly, sporty setting.

name: CURSA IMPOSIBILĂ
description: The Impossible Race is a unique virtual event in which participants reach the finish line one hour before the time they started. It is not a competitive race, but a personal and collective challenge held throughout 2026. Participants can choose from multiple sports and routes, including running, walking, cycling, rollerblading, swimming, and water sports, with a range of distances, some even thousands of kilometers long. The event emphasizes community spirit and supporting causes, and awards a finisher medal to everyone who completes the challenge.

name: Semimaraton Porolissum
organizer: ASOCIATIA CLUBUL SPORTIV TODO RUN ZALĂU
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the heart of history, in the area around the Porolissum Roman Camp in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The event offers three distinct races: the 23 km Half Marathon, the 12 km Salamander Race, and the 1.6 km Fortifications Tour, welcoming runners of all levels. The routes combine the challenge of mountain running with spectacular scenery and historical features, making them ideal for nature and history enthusiasts. The organizers provide a complete experience, with hydration stations, timing, and an awards ceremony.

name: ASCOTID Trail Race
organizer: ASCOTID (Asociația Copiilor și Tinerilor Diabetici - Mureș)
description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual off-road running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes Mureș (ASCOTID). The routes include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a focus on social and health goals.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charity sporting event held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, near Sucevița. The event supports palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of those going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately difficult races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The courses offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a community of runners. The event is a running festival, combining a passion for sport with exploration and recognition of local values. The organizers emphasize a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event held in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, for both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race kits available for pickup in the days leading up to the event and on race day.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country, set amid the scenic landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, with courses that combine physical challenge, storybook scenery, and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and aid stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.

name: RUN FOR LIFE
location: Dumbrava Vlăsiei, Snagov, Ilfov County, Romania

name: Crosul Arenelor
description: Crosul Arenelor is a unique running event in Bucharest, taking place on a 10-kilometer course between two iconic arenas: the Arcul de Triumf National Stadium and the National Arena. The race runs in one direction, with no turnarounds, along the capital’s most beautiful streets, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, and is open to all running enthusiasts. The organizers focus on creating an energizing atmosphere, with cheer points along the course and a complete race kit for runners.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The route starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition—it is a call for movement and community involvement.

The event offers routes adapted for all ages, including races for children and adults, over distances of 3 km and 6 km. The routes are designed to be accessible and enjoyable, following the park’s paths and offering a recreational and competitive outdoor experience. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities dedicated to runners.

name: Crosul Regina Maria
description: Queen Maria Cross is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together the local running community for a competition full of energy and sportsmanship. The course starts near the Horia Demian Sports Hall and offers participants an enjoyable experience in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere. The event is supported by official sponsors and partners, helping ensure smooth operations and amenities for runners. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running outdoors and connect with other enthusiasts.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance race within Zalău Ultra Trail that tests participants’ physical and mental limits. The format involves repeatedly running a course of approximately 6.7 km, with a start at the top of every hour; participants who do not finish the lap in time are eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, making it an extreme challenge of endurance, willpower, and strategy. The event takes place in Poienița Aghireș and is part of the ZUT series, which promotes connection between athletes, the community, and nature.
course_highlights: Approximately 6.7 km course run in successive loops
Starts at the top of every hour, with a time limit of 59 minutes and 30 seconds per loop
Elimination format continues until only one runner remains
additional: Participants must complete each lap in under an hour to continue in the race. The race is extremely demanding, eliminating anyone who is late or withdraws. The organizer recommends careful preparation and strict adherence to the rules for safety and fair play.

name: Veverița Night Run
description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain running race in Bucovina, held in Vatra Dornei, with two medium-difficulty races over 12 km and 22 km. The routes are mainly on mountain trails, with sections through forest and open meadows, starting and finishing at the base of the Veverița ski slope and reaching Diecilor Peak. The event provides hydration and food stations, as well as medical assistance from the Vatra Dornei Mountain Rescue team. Participants should be prepared for mountain running and bring the equipment needed for nighttime and mountain conditions.
course_highlights: 12 km route with 95% mountain trail and 5% paved road
22 km route entirely on mountain trails, with 1161 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the base of the Veverița ski slope, with the highest point at Diecilor Peak (1301 m)
additional: Children can register on-site. Participants must have a headlamp with charged and spare batteries, a mobile phone with a charged battery, their race number visible throughout the race, and suitable equipment for adverse weather conditions. Medical assistance is provided by Vatra Dornei Mountain Rescue; no ambulance will be stationed at the start/finish.

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run is a sporting event that promotes running as a way to support health, solidarity, and community. In Vladimirescu, Arad, participants of all ages are invited to take part in a range of races, from the half-marathon to children’s races, in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere. The event supports social causes and encourages an active lifestyle, bringing together runners of all levels to support the local community.
course_highlights: Varied routes: half-marathon 21 km, sprint 10 km, super sport 5 km, family race 1 km, and children’s races
An event for all ages, from children to adults and seniors
A community atmosphere and support for local social causes
additional: The community meets every Tuesday at 18:00 for group training, on a route from Sala Polivalentă Arad to Stadionul Gloria. The event includes the “MAI DEPARTE” project, dedicated to beginners and those who want to adopt a healthy lifestyle. Minimum ages for the races: 18 for the half-marathon, 14 for the sprint, 12 for super sport, no age limit for the family race, and special races for children aged 6 to 12.

name: Brașov Running Festival
distance_verbose: 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metri, 1.2 km, 0.8 km
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road-running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an atmosphere full of energy, music, and fun. The festival includes a variety of races, from a 5 km race for beginners and races for children to tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with a World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of Brașov’s Tractorul district and offers a complete experience with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.

name: MARZESTI TRAIL RUN ALEARGĂ, FII PARTE DIN NATURĂ!
description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual cross-country running competition held in the Breazu area, in Rediu commune, Iași County, with the start and finish in front of the forestry ranger station in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied courses include wooded areas, meadows, forest roads and agricultural roads, offering a unique running experience in nature, with flat sections, descents and climbs. The event promotes outdoor sports and supports local social causes, providing an opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy themselves and meet. The half-marathon distance and the other races are suitable for different levels of training, and the event includes hydration points and course marshals.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running competition held in Timișoara that promotes a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover yourself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to a full 42 km marathon. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event held in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, organized by Alternative Timișoara Sports Club. The race includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) events on mountain trails that cross the Cerna Mountains and connect the area's 39 hamlets. This outdoor competition showcases the region's natural beauty and the challenges of mountain terrain.

Connecting 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) events

The courses include the full 42 km marathon, the 21 km half marathon, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting in Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban course that passes major landmarks in the capital, with hydration and support stations along the way.

name: Azuga Trail Race
description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport

Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

name: Făget Tour
description: Făget Tour GlobalLogic is a running race organized by Runners Club in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run in nature during one of the most beautiful times of the year. The event includes two main races: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country route in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic views
Routes marked and supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked, and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The race has official partners and supporters. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, offering an opportunity to discover the area's natural beauty and take part in a community sporting event.
