name: ALERGAREA DE SAMBATA - CALARASI
description: The “Saturday Run” Half Marathon in Călărași is a landmark sporting event for the local community, offering races for all ages and fitness levels. The event takes place in Călărași Central Park and includes several events, from short races for children and adults to the half marathon. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities such as water and refreshment stations, as well as personal belongings storage. It is a competition that encourages personal achievement and community spirit.
course_highlights: Varied routes: 3 km, 5 km, and 10.5 km in Călărași Central Park
Water and isotonic drink stations along the route and at the start/finish
Open to all ages, with races for children and a corporate race
additional: Participants receive a bag for storing personal belongings. Registration is available online and by bank transfer. Participants must submit a declaration of responsibility. The corporate race will take place only if there are at least 10 teams. At the finish, runners receive snacks and water.

name: SEMIMARATONUL CRAIOVEI
description: The Craiova Half Marathon is an annual running and fundraising event for community causes, organized by the Romanian Association of Young People with Initiative (A.R.T.I.) in collaboration with SightRunning.ro. The event includes timed half-marathon, 14 km and 7 km races, as well as untimed races and activities for all ages and categories, including people with disabilities and pets. The course is urban, starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade in Craiova, and consists of 7 km loops with an elevation gain of 58 m. Participants support charitable projects in education, health and social inclusion.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade
7 km loops: 3 for the half marathon, 2 for the 14 km race and 1 for the 7 km race
Hydration stations and medical assistance along the course
additional: Race kits can be collected at Electroputere Mall in the days before the event and on event day at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade. The event includes special races for wheelchair users and adaptive sports, as well as untimed races and related activities. Safety measures include law enforcement, volunteers and an ambulance with a doctor along the course.

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Piața Victoriei, offering a unique experience through the story of Eugeniu de Savoya’s arrival. The half marathon and shorter races offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes associated activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and a special anniversary race, “106 pentru POLI.”
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Piața Victoriei
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric neighborhood along the banks of the Bega
The shorter races pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric neighborhood
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Piața Victoriei. The marathon starts with a bus departure at 06:30 from Piața Victoriei to Otelec. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. Participants can choose from several race categories, as well as workshops and a pasta party.

name: Beiuș Running Day
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering races for all ages and experience levels, held in the town of Beiuș. The courses include a free children’s race, a 2 km race for beginners and families, a 10 km race for amateur and semi-professional runners, and a 21.1 km half marathon for experienced runners. The event takes place in Mihai Eminescu Park and on the streets of Beiuș, with safe, well-marked courses that offer an enjoyable and competitive experience. Participants receive prizes, medals, and surprises, while the children’s races are organized with special safety and supervision measures.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths and paved streets in Beiuș
A completely safe children’s race on a flat course closed to vehicle traffic
Prizes and medals for all age groups and distances
additional: The Children’s Race starts at 11:30 and is organized by age categories for children aged 4 to 13, on a completely safe course closed to vehicle traffic. Children participate for free, and parents or guardians must be present throughout the race. The adult races start at 11:00 in Mihai Eminescu Park. Prizes are available for podium finishers, and all participants who complete the race receive medals.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a running event offering a variety of routes around the Hațeg Royal Fortress, combining natural scenery with historical features. Participants can choose between the marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, and family run. All races follow well-marked, technical routes with climbs and descents that challenge both beginners and advanced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, friendly atmosphere, and attractive prizes. Participants are advised to be fit and have suitable sports gear to fully enjoy the experience.
course_highlights: Well-marked, clean routes with technical climbs and descents through hills and forest
Passage through the Hațeg Royal Fortress and natural areas such as Lunca de Jos and the Subcetate meadow
A range of races: marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, and family run
additional: On-site registration is not available, except for the Kids and Family categories, which are limited to 100 places. Participants must have suitable sports gear, and mandatory equipment may be checked at the start and along the route. There is a dedicated race for people with special abilities, “Și eu POT!”.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

name: ISTRITA XSCAPE
description: IstritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, held on the hills, trails, and forest roads around Istrița Hill and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, combining nature with the area’s millennia-old history, including Dacian, Roman, and prehistoric traces. Three races are available: Fun Run, Half Marathon, and Marathon, each featuring spectacular scenery and mountain challenges. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere and amenities such as refreshment stations and individual timing.
course_highlights: Routes across the hills and trails around Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and the city of Buzău
Ascents and descents on forest roads and marked trails
additional: Participants receive a race pack with a race number, individual timing, a finisher’s medal, refreshment stations and on-course support, isotonic drinks at the start/finish, results and an electronic certificate, as well as photo and video materials.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover Romania’s capital in a unique way: by running. The course is flat, fast, and ideal for setting personal records, passing through green parks and combining old architecture with the city’s modern energy. The event is suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs, offering a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It’s the perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city that remains undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course, ideal for personal records
Green parks along the course
A unique blend of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active, healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The course includes hydration stations every 5 km and the energetic atmosphere characteristic of Romania’s capital.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025
